programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 4
programme.desc: Yugi crumples in exhaustion under the crippling power of the Shadow Game. His friends yell desperate encouragement, but their voices cannot penetrate the sphere of darkness. Yugi’s chance at victory is slipping away, as is his life.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 5
programme.desc: Pegasus summons Relinquished, a fearsome monster that can consume Yugi’s Duel Monsters! Yugi counters with… Kuriboh? The smallest, weakest creature in the game? Has Yugi given up, or does he have one last strategy to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat? The Shadow Game comes to a close.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The Pegasus Saga comes to an end, but a new journey is about to begin! Yugi meets a mysterious Egyptian named Shadi who enters Yugi’s mind with the Millennium Key. What are these Millennium Items, and do they hold the answer to the mystery behind the Shadow Games.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi and friends return from the Duelist Kingdom only to meet a young girl named Rebecca who demands that Grandpa return Blue-Eyes White Dragon to her! She’s here to claim back the card that Grandpa stole from her grandfather many years ago.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Rebecca mistakenly believes that Grandpa stole Blue-Eyes White Dragon from her grandfather. Yugi must defend Blue-Eyes White Dragon to teach her that it’s not the power of the cards, but the heart that’s in them that counts.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The two-faced Board of Directors of KaibaCorp trap Kaiba inside a virtual reality game! Mokuba recruits Yugi and Joey to free Kaiba from this ultimate game where losing equals death.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The quest for Kaiba continues with a little help from… Mai? But can Yugi and friends adapt to a virtual world where the rules and strategies keep changing every step of the way.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: After Duke’s all-powerful Orgoth the Relentless dices Yugi’s entire cadre of monsters into shreds, Yugi only has one turn left before he loses all his heart points! Yugi’s last hope rests in one final dice roll in the thrilling conclusion to Dungeon Dice Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Jack appears to taunt Yuya over his fear of using his counterpart's dragons in fear of summoning Zarc. Unable to accomplish anything as is, Yuya challenges Jack to a duel while Reiji makes it so everyone can watch the battle.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya finally listens to his other selves and summons all four of his dragons to defeat Jack. However, there is one final challenge before him in order to become a Dueltainer and purge Zarc: his rival and friend Reiji Akaba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The curtain is about to fall for the last time. The final battle between Yuya and Reiji rages on. Dragons face off against D/D/D as the whole world watches. What will be the final fate of Yuya, Yuzu, and all four dueling dimensions.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Feel the flow for the final time as Yuma and Astral high-five the sky in the cosmic conclusion to Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi and friends rescue Kaiba, but they are still stuck in the game! The only exit is past Five-Headed Dragon, but in the difficult duel, Joey, Mokuba, and Mai lose all their life points! Can Yugi and Kaiba, two former opponents, work together and face the biggest enemy of their lives.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: A new student, Duke Devlin, defeats Joey in a game of Duel Monsters, forcing Joey to become his servant. Duke forces Joey to wear a dog costume and humiliates him in public, forcing Yugi to challenge Duke to a duel. However, this will not be a Duel Monsters duel, but a new game named Dungeon Dice Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: In exchange for Joey’s freedom, Yugi agrees to give up Duel Monsters forever if he loses. Unfamiliar with the rules, Yugi gets off to a rough start. His chances do not improve as Duke reveals that he designed Dungeon Dice Monsters with Pegasus’s aid! Can Yugi learn the new complex rules, much less form a strategy, before he is soundly defeated.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi uses his innate gaming skills to turn the tables on Duke, but Duke has one more rule to mention: All creatures take up territory on the grid-like board. With no room to summon any new monsters, Yugi’s position is helpless.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: An arcane fortune teller steals the Millennium Puzzle, and Yugi must defeat him in a duel to win it back! However, this is no ordinary soothsayer; he’s a familiar and formidable foe from Duelist Kingdom… or is he? Can Yugi beat him all alone without the help of his friends or the spirit inside the Puzzle.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The mysterious menace controlling Bandit Keith shatters the Millennium Puzzle into pieces before setting the dueling arena ablaze! Can Yugi put the Millennium Puzzle back together and save the spirit before the entire room is engulfed in flames.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The origin of Duel Monsters is revealed! Using the magic of the Millennium Necklace, Egyptian historian Ishizu Ishtar shows Kaiba how Duel Monsters was played millenniums ago! The ancient games have resurrected in modern times, along with three almighty beasts of unstoppable devastation – the Egyptian God Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The spirit of the Millennium Puzzle realizes that his memories of ancient Egypt have faded, but Téa is going to help him uncover the mysteries of his past! However, their search is interrupted by the dancing duelist Johnny Steps and his musical monsters of rock.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: To face the future, Yugi must first look into the past! Yugi learns that he was a powerful Pharaoh who saved the world five thousand years ago, and he must now save the world again! Meanwhile, Kaiba tests the hidden powers of his Egyptian God Card Obelisk the Tormentor against the fury of Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Joey is cornered by a group of sinister Rare Hunters who force Joey into a duel where if Joey loses, the Rare Hunters get his precious Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Though Joey pummels his foes with his mighty monster armada, eliminating life points isn’t the only path to victory.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Rare Hunter, Part 1: Battle City Begins
programme.desc: It’s time to master new rules and monsters; let the Battle City Tournament commence! In the first duel of the tournament, Yugi challenges the Rare Hunter to win back Joey’s Red-Eyes B. Dragon. However, Yugi’s falling into the same trap that led to Joey’s demise.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Rare Hunter, Part 2: Up Against Exodia
programme.desc: Yugi figures out the Rare Hunter’s strategy to summon the almighty Exodia, but it’s too late to stop him! The Rare Hunter already has four pieces of Exodia in his hand, and the fifth and final piece is on top of his deck! How can Yugi stop the unstoppable Exodia.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The psychic duelist Espa Roba defeats Rex Raptor as easy as a chumpasaurus, and Joey’s next on his hit list! What chance does Joey have when Espa Roba has the telepathic ability to read all the cards in Joey’s hand.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Joey discovers that Espa Roba’s extrasensory perception is a hoax, but he’s not yet free from Espa's mental manipulations! Espa Roba’s Jinzo not only slaughters all of Joey’s monsters, but it grows in power every turn! Joey’s luck has come to an end… or has it.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The magician duelist Arkana transports Yugi to the world’s most lethal dueling arena where the loser gets sent to the Shadow Realm! Yugi must win this duel or he'll lose much more than his Dark Magician.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: It’s Dark Magician versus Dark Magician! However, while Yugi only controls one Dark Magician, Arkana has three residing in his deck! Though outnumbered, Yugi will never give up, as long as he believes in the heart of the cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: To counter Arkana’s Dark Magician, Yugi pulls a rabbit out of his hat: Dark Magician Girl! It’s the battle of the sexes to determine the true master of magicians.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Warren and the group are taken prisoner while Murphy manages to escape with his newly formed group of blends.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: While on the road to establish his headquarters in Spokane, Murphy saves the life of a dying girl. When her parents show up and ask to be bitten too, his mission gains momentum. Meanwhile, Warren leads the new mission group to a strange town.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: As more people flock to Murphy's new cult, Dr. Merch works on a blend vaccine as well as a booster shot to slow to Murphy's descent into zombiedom.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Alone and suffering from the effects of Merch's booster, 10K barely escapes Murphy and is stalked by a blend.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Doc finds himself taken captive by a psychotic nurse and her surviving mental patients, and he later discovers that 10K is being held too.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Seemingly injected with the blend vaccine, The Man attempts to kidnap Murphy but underestimates the strength of Murphy's followers. However, he does manage to learn about Lucy's existence. 10K reunites with the group.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Looking for Lucy, Doc and Addy run into Skeezy and Sketch, who is running for "President of the Apocalypse.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Warren and the others inspect Murphytown and realize they are going to need a bigger army to extract Murphy. Warren finds an old ally in El Escorpion.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Upon finding Lucy, Doc and Addy work hard to stay alive and earn the family's trust. After a dangerous game of zombie hide-and-seek, an apocalyptic fairytale and a close call with an ender, Addy and Doc convince the family to follow them to Murphy.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Doc tries to find a way to tell Warren about Lucy's kidnapping. In the meantime, he encounters a radio tower and castle-like compound inhabited by three attractive, crafty ladies.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Warren leads an attack against Murphytown to extract its smug leader.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Addy is being pummeled with whatever The Man can throw at her - and Lucy does the same right back.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Addy and Doc catch up with Warren, but the reunion is short-lived as the group faces the biggest battle yet.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Two years later, things have gotten worse: Warren's apocalyptic dreams continue while the group fights MAD-Zs.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Bleeding Steel
programme.desc: Jackie Chan spiller hovedrollen som Lin, en agent for spesialstyrken i Hong Kong. Under et oppdrag havner teamet til Lin i et bakholdsangrep, og Lin er farlig nær døden.

programme.title: The Shanghai Job
programme.desc: En utbrent sikkerhetsagent for et privat selskap får i oppdrag å eskortere en verdifull kinesisk antikvitet fra Shanghai. Men på veien møter han på standhaftige problemer.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In Latin America
programme.desc: Healing effects, fragrance, and intense flavor – the benefits of herbs were discovered by the indigenous peoples of South America long before Spanish conquistadores subdued the continent. Even today, in the remote regions of South America, life without herbs is unthinkable. For many inhabitants, they provide the sole medicine. For more than two thousand years, this wisdom of the healing powers of nature has been passed down from generation to generation. In Bolivia, the film accompanies ethnobiologist Rainer Bussmann on one of his expeditions documenting which herbs the locals use against which illnesses. The German scientist has spent the last 15 years in the region, focussed on preserving this invaluable knowledge.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: As contrasting as the landscapes of the 15th meridian east, so different are its animal inhabitants. What are the living conditions like in the heat of the Namibian Damaraland, in Lusatia or on the coast of Norway? Which challenges do elephants, whales or kingfishers have to master together with their companions from north to south.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: Almost 11000 kilometres lie between the northernmost and southernmost point of the 15th meridian east. Here you will find extreme landscapes such as the shimmering heat of Africa or the eternal cold of northern Scandinavia. Five people from Spitsbergen, Namibia, Slovenia, Germany and Poland dedicate their lives to environmental protection.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: This episode focuses on people from five countries who share a common passion: The production of their own food and food. What culinary treasures are hidden in the different regions, from Spitsbergen to Sweden, Austria, Poland and Chad.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.sub-title: The Road To Death In The Andes
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world’s ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn’s house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver’s personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Inside China's Q3 Economy
programme.desc: China's economy expanded 4.6% in the first three quarters, with exports and high-tech manufacturing continuing to provide support, while consumption and industrial output picked up in September. What do the latest numbers reveal about China's growth momentum and economic transformation? Can renewed momentum and an improved structure help sustain growth in the months ahead? Join BizTalk as leading economists and experts take a closer look at China's Q3 economic performance, unpack the key signals behind the headline numbers, and assess the outlook for growth.

programme.title: Adidas CEO: Competition with Chinese brands makes us better
programme.desc: German sportswear giant Adidas has been in China for decades, but it's no longer just selling a European playbook. Its "In China, For China" model puts designers, creatives and supply chains directly into the bustle of the world's second largest economy - where competition is fierce and Chinese sportswear brands are stronger than ever. Recently in Shanghai, CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu caught up with Adidas global CEO Bjørn Gulden to find out more.

programme.title: Live promo: Small products, big industry: Meet the Canton Fair's manufacturing 'hidden champions
programme.desc: At the 140th Canton Fair on Saturday, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, a German tool importer and longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors ranging from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. What can seemingly ordinary products tell us about the strength of a much larger industry.

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down..

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Murder among ranchers is the subject of this Republic Pictures drama. Starring such names as Rex Allen, Slim Pickins, and Chester Clute, this feature was directed by William Whitney. For Trivia Buffs: At one time Whitney was known as the youngest director in Hollywood, having been hired by the newly formed Republic Pictures at the tender age of 21.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951.

programme.title: Enemy of the Law
programme.desc: Tex Ritter stars in this western drama about a man who goes undercover to befriend a convict believed to have stolen a shipment of government gold. Also starring Guy Wilkerson as Panhandle Perkins, this offering from Hollywoods Poverty Row features the usual fistfights and entertaining storyline that made these modestly budgeted features well worth watching. Songs include Teach Me To Forget and You Will Have to Pay both sung by Tex.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Six Gun Trail
programme.desc: Legendary cowboy star Tim McCoy stars as Captain William Carson, who along with his sidekick Magpie does battle with jewel thieves. Its an actionfilled drama of the West, with plenty of blazing guns and heman adventure! There are a couple of songs, too, including Moon Over the Plains but they arent sung by Tim McCoy. He was too darned tough to sing! Also starring Nora Lane, Ben Corbet; directed by Sam Newfield.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as Fuzzy Q. Jones.

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: The end of the Mexican-American War finds a brazen U.S. Calvary captain and his men taking over a Spanish land grant. Albert C. Gannaway (The Badge of Marshall Brennan) directs an all-star cast including Jim Davis (Jock Ewing of Dallas), Arleen Whelan (Young Mr. Lincoln) and Lee Van Cleef (The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly). Also, look for appearances by legendary country & western stars Marty Robbins and Faron Young.

programme.title: The Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: A mining engineer tries to solve the murders of several heirs to a valuable radium mine in this western drama from Paramount Pictures. Stars include Charles Chic Sale, and in one of his early roles, Randolph Scott. This feature, also known as Rocky Mountain Mystery, was directed by Oscar winner Charles Barton, who would go on to direct several popular television shows, including Petticoat Junction and Family Affair..

programme.title: Origini
programme.sub-title: S01:E02 Tra Reggio e Messina lo Stretto necessario
programme.desc: Valentina Caruso and Francesco Gasparri explore the Strait of Messina, where unique underwater currents create an oceanic ecosystem within the Mediterranean. Diver Domenico Majolino and marine biologist Simona Ratti explain its natural wonders, while Vincenzo Annuario tells the story of the Cariddi ferry, reborn after serving in the navy. At the National Archaeological Museum of Reggio Calabria, we discover the legacy of Magna Grecia and the famous Riace Bronzes. The 1908 earthquake that devastated Messina and Reggio Calabria is commemorated at the Regional Museum of Messina with the exhibition "1908 City Museum".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 4
programme.desc: Yugi crumples in exhaustion under the crippling power of the Shadow Game. His friends yell desperate encouragement, but their voices cannot penetrate the sphere of darkness. Yugi’s chance at victory is slipping away, as is his life.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 5
programme.desc: Pegasus summons Relinquished, a fearsome monster that can consume Yugi’s Duel Monsters! Yugi counters with… Kuriboh? The smallest, weakest creature in the game? Has Yugi given up, or does he have one last strategy to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat? The Shadow Game comes to a close.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The Pegasus Saga comes to an end, but a new journey is about to begin! Yugi meets a mysterious Egyptian named Shadi who enters Yugi’s mind with the Millennium Key. What are these Millennium Items, and do they hold the answer to the mystery behind the Shadow Games.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi and friends return from the Duelist Kingdom only to meet a young girl named Rebecca who demands that Grandpa return Blue-Eyes White Dragon to her! She’s here to claim back the card that Grandpa stole from her grandfather many years ago.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Rebecca mistakenly believes that Grandpa stole Blue-Eyes White Dragon from her grandfather. Yugi must defend Blue-Eyes White Dragon to teach her that it’s not the power of the cards, but the heart that’s in them that counts.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The two-faced Board of Directors of KaibaCorp trap Kaiba inside a virtual reality game! Mokuba recruits Yugi and Joey to free Kaiba from this ultimate game where losing equals death.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The quest for Kaiba continues with a little help from… Mai? But can Yugi and friends adapt to a virtual world where the rules and strategies keep changing every step of the way.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: After Duke’s all-powerful Orgoth the Relentless dices Yugi’s entire cadre of monsters into shreds, Yugi only has one turn left before he loses all his heart points! Yugi’s last hope rests in one final dice roll in the thrilling conclusion to Dungeon Dice Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Jack appears to taunt Yuya over his fear of using his counterpart's dragons in fear of summoning Zarc. Unable to accomplish anything as is, Yuya challenges Jack to a duel while Reiji makes it so everyone can watch the battle.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya finally listens to his other selves and summons all four of his dragons to defeat Jack. However, there is one final challenge before him in order to become a Dueltainer and purge Zarc: his rival and friend Reiji Akaba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The curtain is about to fall for the last time. The final battle between Yuya and Reiji rages on. Dragons face off against D/D/D as the whole world watches. What will be the final fate of Yuya, Yuzu, and all four dueling dimensions.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Feel the flow for the final time as Yuma and Astral high-five the sky in the cosmic conclusion to Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi and friends rescue Kaiba, but they are still stuck in the game! The only exit is past Five-Headed Dragon, but in the difficult duel, Joey, Mokuba, and Mai lose all their life points! Can Yugi and Kaiba, two former opponents, work together and face the biggest enemy of their lives.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: A new student, Duke Devlin, defeats Joey in a game of Duel Monsters, forcing Joey to become his servant. Duke forces Joey to wear a dog costume and humiliates him in public, forcing Yugi to challenge Duke to a duel. However, this will not be a Duel Monsters duel, but a new game named Dungeon Dice Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: In exchange for Joey’s freedom, Yugi agrees to give up Duel Monsters forever if he loses. Unfamiliar with the rules, Yugi gets off to a rough start. His chances do not improve as Duke reveals that he designed Dungeon Dice Monsters with Pegasus’s aid! Can Yugi learn the new complex rules, much less form a strategy, before he is soundly defeated.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi uses his innate gaming skills to turn the tables on Duke, but Duke has one more rule to mention: All creatures take up territory on the grid-like board. With no room to summon any new monsters, Yugi’s position is helpless.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: An arcane fortune teller steals the Millennium Puzzle, and Yugi must defeat him in a duel to win it back! However, this is no ordinary soothsayer; he’s a familiar and formidable foe from Duelist Kingdom… or is he? Can Yugi beat him all alone without the help of his friends or the spirit inside the Puzzle.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The mysterious menace controlling Bandit Keith shatters the Millennium Puzzle into pieces before setting the dueling arena ablaze! Can Yugi put the Millennium Puzzle back together and save the spirit before the entire room is engulfed in flames.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The origin of Duel Monsters is revealed! Using the magic of the Millennium Necklace, Egyptian historian Ishizu Ishtar shows Kaiba how Duel Monsters was played millenniums ago! The ancient games have resurrected in modern times, along with three almighty beasts of unstoppable devastation – the Egyptian God Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The spirit of the Millennium Puzzle realizes that his memories of ancient Egypt have faded, but Téa is going to help him uncover the mysteries of his past! However, their search is interrupted by the dancing duelist Johnny Steps and his musical monsters of rock.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: To face the future, Yugi must first look into the past! Yugi learns that he was a powerful Pharaoh who saved the world five thousand years ago, and he must now save the world again! Meanwhile, Kaiba tests the hidden powers of his Egyptian God Card Obelisk the Tormentor against the fury of Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Joey is cornered by a group of sinister Rare Hunters who force Joey into a duel where if Joey loses, the Rare Hunters get his precious Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Though Joey pummels his foes with his mighty monster armada, eliminating life points isn’t the only path to victory.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Rare Hunter, Part 1: Battle City Begins
programme.desc: It’s time to master new rules and monsters; let the Battle City Tournament commence! In the first duel of the tournament, Yugi challenges the Rare Hunter to win back Joey’s Red-Eyes B. Dragon. However, Yugi’s falling into the same trap that led to Joey’s demise.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Rare Hunter, Part 2: Up Against Exodia
programme.desc: Yugi figures out the Rare Hunter’s strategy to summon the almighty Exodia, but it’s too late to stop him! The Rare Hunter already has four pieces of Exodia in his hand, and the fifth and final piece is on top of his deck! How can Yugi stop the unstoppable Exodia.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The psychic duelist Espa Roba defeats Rex Raptor as easy as a chumpasaurus, and Joey’s next on his hit list! What chance does Joey have when Espa Roba has the telepathic ability to read all the cards in Joey’s hand.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Joey discovers that Espa Roba’s extrasensory perception is a hoax, but he’s not yet free from Espa's mental manipulations! Espa Roba’s Jinzo not only slaughters all of Joey’s monsters, but it grows in power every turn! Joey’s luck has come to an end… or has it.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The magician duelist Arkana transports Yugi to the world’s most lethal dueling arena where the loser gets sent to the Shadow Realm! Yugi must win this duel or he'll lose much more than his Dark Magician.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: It’s Dark Magician versus Dark Magician! However, while Yugi only controls one Dark Magician, Arkana has three residing in his deck! Though outnumbered, Yugi will never give up, as long as he believes in the heart of the cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: To counter Arkana’s Dark Magician, Yugi pulls a rabbit out of his hat: Dark Magician Girl! It’s the battle of the sexes to determine the true master of magicians.

programme.title: Lies of the Heart
programme.sub-title: Lies of the Heart S1 E9
programme.desc: A woman's struggle in this male dominated society that will leave her to embark on a quest of eternal marital bliss.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.sub-title: A King and His Queen S2 E21
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land.

programme.title: A Baleia Cantora (VP)
programme.desc: Quando uma criatura monstruosa foge de um icebergue que está a derreter, uma baleia-jubarte, cheia de inseguranças, tem de enfrentar os seus medos e mergulhar nas profundezas para descobrir uma canção mística capaz de salvar os oceanos da destruição.

programme.title: Planeta Willy (VP)
programme.desc: Após a destruição da sua nave, o pequeno Willy separa-se dos pais e a sua cápsula aterra num planeta selvagem. Com a ajuda de Buck, um robô de sobrevivência, ele tem de esperar pela missão de resgate enquanto descobre o planeta e os seus perigos.

programme.title: Ladrões de Elite
programme.desc: Após ser recrutado por um grupo de ladrões pouco convencionais, o famoso criminoso Richard Pace - que se gaba de roubar apenas quem tem seguro para não lesar ninguém - vê-se envolvido num elaborado roubo de ouro.

programme.title: Nuremberga (2025)
programme.desc: 1945, Alemanha. Os aliados têm a missão de garantir que o regime nazi responde pelos horrores do Holocausto, ao mesmo tempo que um psiquiatra do exército americano trava um intenso duelo psicológico com o ex-Reichsmarschall Hermann Göring.

programme.title: Canary Black
programme.desc: Avery Graves, elite da CIA, enfrenta o impossível: terroristas raptam o marido e exigem que o traia. Com contactos sombrios e fúria implacável, a agente vira o jogo num thriller de alta rodagem.

programme.title: Inverno Mortal
programme.desc: Sozinha numa tempestade de neve em Minnesota, uma viúva procura cumprir o último desejo do marido. Ao parar numa cabana remota, descobre uma rapariga raptada e torna-se na sua única esperança de sobrevivência numa luta contra o tempo.

programme.title: Nos héros du quotidien
programme.sub-title: Comparutions immédiates : justice en temps réel
programme.desc: Plongez au cœur du quotidien de ceux qui veillent sur notre sécurité et notre santé : policiers, gendarmes, pompiers, équipes du SAMU, etc. À travers la réalité des interventions, cette série met en lumière leur engagement, leur sang-froid face à l'urgence, et les défis humains auxquels ils sont confrontés chaque jour. Une immersion saisissante dans le quotidien de femmes et d'hommes d'exception, animés par un seul objectif : protéger, secourir, servir.

programme.title: Hinter Gittern – Der Frauenknast
programme.desc:
Denises Sponsor verlangt, sie solle schwanger werden, um öffentliche Aufmerksamkeit zu erregen.

Die ehemalige Schließerin Silke Jakoby kehrt als Gefangene nach Reutlitz zurück. Sie gerät in einen Loyalitätskonflikt zwischen Schnoor und den Frauen.

Als Ruth vom Tod des von ihr attackierten Polizisten erfährt, legt sie die Nonnentracht ab und zieht sich zurück.

Wenig später wird sie von Walter, der Bea nicht besuchen darf, als Geisel genommen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hinter Gittern – Der Frauenknast
programme.desc:
Simone sehnt sich nach Helmut und verlangt, dass er für ein ungestörtes Treffen sorgt.

Derweil wird Silke von den Vattke-Schwestern gequält und wendet sich hilfesuchend an Uschi.

Denise ist von Jörg schwanger und hofft nun auf eine frühzeitige Entlassung. Jörg streitet die Vaterschaft jedoch vehement ab. Als ein Vaterschaftstest endgültig Klarheit schaffen soll, sorgt Jörg dafür, dass Denise das Kind verliert. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hinter Gittern – Der Frauenknast
programme.desc: Als Jutta sowohl den Besuch von Nina bei Walter untersagt als auch das Zusammentreffen von Helmut und Simone verhindert, schmiedet Walter, die Helmut bei der Badrenovierung helfen soll, ihrerseits einen Plan, wie die beiden Treffen dennoch zustande kommen könnten.\n\nWährenddessen plant Silke ihre Flucht aus Reutlitz, nachdem ihr Antrag auf Revision abgelehnt wurde. Doch ihr Fluchtversuch, den sie mit Schnoors Hilfe organisiert, endet tragisch. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ik Vertrek
programme.desc: Sportleraar Sjors (41) en ambtenaar Sofie (41) verhuizen met hun zoons Billy (11) en Flynn (8) naar het Franse Ambert. Ze nemen een bestaande camping over die ze willen vernieuwen met safaritenten, een zwembad en een speeltuin. Voor de jongens is de emigratie wennen. Ze moeten afscheid nemen van familie en vrienden en naar een Franse school waar ze de taal niet spreken. Ondertussen is het terrein al snel volgeboekt vanwege een muziekfestival in de buurt.

programme.title: Noord-Zuid-Oost-West
programme.desc: In Margreet: er gaat geen dag voorbij of er is nieuws over een azc, maar wat gebeurt er nu eigenlijk echt in een asielzoekerscentrum? Het azc in Leersum is het oudste asielzoekerscentrum van de provincie Utrecht. Er wonen ruim 500 mensen. Hoe houd je zo'n 'dorp in een dorp' leefbaar voor iedereen? 80 Prachtig! vertelt het verhaal van 80'ers die zich niet laten weerhouden door hun leeftijd om te doen wat ze willen doen.

programme.desc: Kringloopwinkels afstruinen is de favoriete bezigheid van de eigenaar van twee 'space-achtige' kandelaars. Rob Driessen gaat met de eigenaar naar de ontwerper, Gijs Bakker. Bakker was een van de belangrijkste Nederlandse industriële ontwerpers.

programme.title: Nu te Zien!
programme.desc: Bart van Rutten van Centraal Museum Utrecht maakt in het Dordrechts Museum een reis door de nacht bij de tentoonstelling From Dusk till Dawn. De expositie toont hoe de nacht werd verbeeld in de zeventiende-eeuwse schilderkunst; een periode waarin het na zonsondergang nog echt aardedonker was. Met meesterwerken van onder anderen Gerrit Dou, Albert Cuyp en Gesina ter Borch.

programme.title: Jazzportretten

programme.title: Boy George & Culture Club
programme.desc: Culture Club brak in 1981 door vanuit de Britse New Romantic-scene met een opvallende stijl en aanstekelijke popmuziek. Een blik op hun muzikale reis, de drugsproblemen van zanger Boy George en de onverwachte liefdesrelatie binnen de band.

programme.title: ADE 2026: Children Of The Night
programme.desc: Tijdens deze ADE-special neemt presentator Justin Verkijk je mee naar het grootste elektronische muziekfestival ter wereld. Met reportages, portretten en bijzondere registraties.

programme.title: Meshell Ndegeocello - Live at Le Guess Who?
programme.desc: Registratie van het optreden dat Meshell Ndegeocello gaf tijdens festival Le Guess Who? 2024.

programme.title: Jazzportretten
programme.desc: Gitarist en componist Franky Douglas is een veelgevraagde sideman in bands die jazz vermengen met Afrikaanse en Caribische invloeden, zoals Louis Moholo's Viva La Black, Sean Bergin's MOB en Funky World van Wolter Wierbos.

programme.title: Rave Culture - The Birth of Dance Music
programme.desc: Rave Culture duikt in de explosieve opkomst van de Britse ravebeweging van begin jaren 90, aangewakkerd door massale werkloosheid, een stijgende populariteit van amfetaminen en een nieuwe golf muzikanten, producers en artiesten.

programme.title: Tussen Kunst en Kitsch Extra
programme.desc: Special waarin verder wordt ingegaan op voorwerpen en gebeurtenissen uit de reguliere uitzendingen van 'Tussen kunst en kitsch'.

programme.title: Immersive World
programme.desc: Een verkenning van interactieve verhalen en ervaringskunst, van meeslepend theater tot virtual reality. Door middel van interviews met kunstenaars, curatoren, regisseurs en schrijvers verkent elke aflevering een aspect van meeslepende ervaringen.

programme.title: Opera Now

programme.desc: Hans Abrahamsen hervertelt een sprookje als een muzikaal gedicht over kindertijd en herinnering. Een fijnzinnige en visueel treffende reis door zijn klankuniversum.

programme.title: Live: Podium Klassiek
programme.desc: Floris ontvangt Susan Smit, die een boek schreef over het leven van Hildegard van Bingen. Wishful Singing laat horen hoe de wereld van Hildegard klonk. Jonge Held is violist Yente Lottman.

programme.title: Vroege Vogels
programme.desc: Het laatste bewoonde eiland in het oosten van de Wadden is Schiermonnikoog. Bestookt door meeuwen bezoeken we een lepelaarskolonie. We komen erachter dat elke sprinkhaan zijn eigen stem heeft en we volgen de lompe sporen van de imposante sayaguesarunderen. Op dit kleine eiland maken de inwoners een vuist tegen de verzuring, en Menno vaart naar de meest afgelegen plekken om (plastic) afval te verzamelen.

programme.title: Dwars door de Pyreneeën
programme.desc: Arnout komt aan in het dwergstaatje Andorra en stuit er op een bijzonder stukje Nederlandse geschiedenis, gekruid met ronkende motoren en een vleugje Eurovisiesongfestival. Daarna ruilt hij de motorhelm in voor een ticket op 'De Kanarie': de iconische gele trein die over de hoogvlaktes van de Franse Cerdagne richting de kust dendert. Onderweg gaat Arnout op bezoek bij de Franse elitetroepen in Mont Louis en belandt hij in een verlaten stationnetje bij een moderne kluizenaar.

programme.desc: Kleding lijkt steeds vaker een wegwerpproduct, maar overal ter wereld zijn er mensen die er juist heel bewust mee omgaan. In Kenia pleit Blessing voor een leven zonder bh: comfortabeler, en beter voor haar rug.

programme.title: Coop Troop

programme.title: Zappsport
programme.desc: Sportprogramma waarin Britt Dekker en Nathan Rutjes de bekendste sporters uitdagen en de meest bizarre wensen laten uitkomen.

programme.title: Ongezien
programme.desc: Jurre en Sahil proberen ongezien te blijven voor een van de bekendste Nederlandse artiesten: Dutchtuber. Tijdens een festival volgen ze Job, die samen met DJ Billy the Kit optreedt. Met hulp van zijn manager Julia en Billy, voeren ze drie uitdagende opdrachten uit. Ze moeten Job vertragen, hem verrassen en uiteindelijk zelfs samen met hem optreden! Lukt het ze om hun missie te volbrengen zonder dat Job doorheeft dat Jurre en Sahil achter de streken zitten?

programme.title: Checkpoint
programme.desc: Rachel rijdt op de velg van een auto, het team test mogelijkheden met een scooter en brengt de brandgevaren van serpentine in beeld. En wie zijn de beste met winkelwagentjes?

programme.title: Welkom bij 75 jaar Jeugd TV
programme.desc: Eenmalige special over 75 jaar jeugdtelevisie van eigen bodem, met Pippi Langkous als iets te energieke hoofdgast op de bank bij Dorine. Met o.a. de eerste tv-uitzending, Theo en Thea en de redding van Het Klokhuis.

programme.title: Welkom thuis
programme.desc: Stap in de chaotische wereld van zeven gezinnen. Eén ding wordt al snel duidelijk: ouders doen maar wat in de hoop dat het goed komt en kinderen generen zich kapot voor alles wat hun ouders doen.

programme.title: Brugklas marathon
programme.desc: Scripted-reality jeugdserie waarin een vaste groep leerlingen gevolgd wordt tijdens het eerste jaar van de middelbare school. Voor schoolgaande kinderen met herkenbare en aangrijpende verhalen.

programme.title: Zappbios: Gugu's wereld
programme.desc: Gugu woont bij zijn oma Dilma, bij wie hij liefde en vrijheid vindt. Hun hechte band trotseert afwijzing van Gugu's vader en van buitenaf, totdat Dilma's broze gezondheid Gugu's wereld doet wankelen.

programme.title: ZappDoc: Het ratje, de mens en de metro
programme.desc: Staartje, een nieuwsgierig ratje, geboren en getogen in de Amsterdamse metro, reist via de Noord-Zuidlijn door de stad. Ze wil begrijpen waarom mensen altijd meer willen, sneller, beter, groter en nooit tevreden lijken. Waarom is genoeg nog altijd niet genoeg? Staartje bestudeert het vreemde gedrag van de mens en ontdekt dat de mens een groter ongedierte is dan de rat.

programme.title: Vlogmania kort
programme.desc: Jaylinn doet haar make-up, maar Jordy verpest haar vlog. De familie Kick doet een bijzondere vondst in de kringloopwinkel.

programme.title: Escape from Albatros
programme.desc: Jayson en Maud bedenken samen met opa Robert en oma Debby een ontsnappingsplan dat bijna mislukt, maar toch weten de vier weg te varen van het eiland Albatros.

programme.title: Hoofdzaken
programme.desc: Tex wenst dat de hele wereld een lach op zijn gezicht heeft en ontdekt zelfs een smiley in de kapsalon. Ravi vertelde halverwege haar schooljaar iets aan de klas wat ze zelf al sinds haar vierde jaar wist en Jehneo oefent voor zijn verkiezingstoespraak als eerste dansende burgemeester van Rotterdam.

programme.title: Topdoks
programme.desc: Elbert en Tim doen een militaire oefening en moeten een gewonde militair veilig en precies op de afgesproken tijd in de gepantserde Boxer-ambulance zien te krijgen.

programme.title: Wilde buren alleen maar love
programme.desc: Er is in Nederland grote woningnood, maar wist je dat er ook een enorm woningtekort voor vogels is? Wildebras gaat dit probleem te lijf en bezoekt vogelhuisjesbouwer Dylan. Voor elke vogel levert hij maatwerk; een mooi ontwerp, het juiste hout en met een perfecte plek in de boom. Samen met Jan de Vogelman zien we bijzondere soorten zoals de grasmus, het vuurhaantje en de roodstaart en kijken we naar de woningbehoefte van deze zeldzame vogeltjes.

programme.title: Rachel valt binnen
programme.desc: Rachel onderzoekt een fictieve moord met echte experts. Er is een dode man gevonden in een park. De politie vermoedt dat het om een misdrijf gaat. Wie is deze man? Is hij vermoord in het park of op een andere plek? Wie heeft hem voor het laatst gezien? Rachel loopt mee vanaf de plaats delict tot in de rechtbank. Komt het tot een veroordeling?

programme.title: Live: Draadstaal
programme.desc: Satirisch sketchprogramma waarin Jeroen van Koningsbrugge en Dennis van de Ven in de huid kruipen van onbekende Nederlanders. Ze geven een stem aan de Nederlanders die zich een weg banen door allerlei persoonlijke en maatschappelijke crises.

programme.title: Sluipschutters
programme.desc: Van autocircuit tot buurthuis, en van kerk tot slagerij. De Sluipschutters verplaatsen zich weer in een moordend tempo. Vlijmscherp, humoristisch sketchprogramma met de vier vrienden Ronald Goedemondt, Bas Hoeflaak, Leo Alkemade en Jochen Otten.

programme.title: Promenade presenteert: Promemedia
programme.desc: Nu Promemedia stappen maakt, vindt Diederik het tijd voor een professionaliseringsslag. Betere apparatuur, strakkere programmering. Het functioneren van Eva blijft een kleine zorg.

programme.title: Boerderij van Dorst
programme.sub-title: Noraly Beyer en Frank van Leeuwen
programme.desc: Noraly Beyer en Frank van Leeuwen komen Raven van Dorst helpen op de boerderij. Samen leggen ze een wijngaard aan. Raven en Noraly halen de wijnranken op, waarna Frank en Raven aan de slag gaan met het planten. Noraly verzorgt een uitgebreid diner en Frank sluit de avond met Raven af in de hot tub. De volgende dag worden de ijzerdraden voor de druiven gespannen, bouwen Frank en Raven een krabpaal voor de geiten en zaait Noraly een nieuw gewas in.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Een aanstaande moeder krijgt een epileptische aanval tijdens de bevalling. Nalan moet direct ingrijpen, terwijl ze zelf worstelt met de brokstukken van haar relatie. Anna merkt dat ze terugvalt in oude patronen binnen haar gezin. Ze moet haar vooroordelen onder ogen zien bij een homostel dat een draagmoeder inschakelt. Greta probeert dokter Mohn te vergeten.

programme.title: Mojo Fliptop
programme.desc: De wijzer van de klokkentoren is weg en dat is de schuld van burgemeester Sunita. Mojo en Bo proberen de toren binnen te sluipen, die nu goed bewaakt wordt door de rest.

programme.title: Lassie Animated
programme.desc: Zoe, Lassie en Harvey gaan de bergen in als het meer droger wordt en de dieren niet kunnen drinken.

programme.title: Moomin Vallei
programme.sub-title: De zonderlinge geschiedenis van mevrouw Fillifjonk
programme.desc: Mevrouw Filifjonk is verdwenen en haar huis is een puinhoop. Moominmama wordt verdacht van moord en belandt in de cel. Samen met Moomintroll ontsnapt ze en verstopt zich in het bos. Moominpapa is vastbesloten samen met Snif het mysterie op te lossen.

programme.title: Coop Troop
programme.desc: De troep haast zich naar Bertha om een paar scherpe stekels weg te halen die vastzitten aan haar achterste. De troep splitst zich op, één team gaat op zoek naar de aanvaller en de andere probeert de stekels te verwijderen zonder gebeten te worden.

programme.title: BarnKidz
programme.desc: Lina en Haas doen een wedstrijd wie de meeste eetbare paddenstoelen kan verzamelen.

programme.title: Machtige Mike
programme.desc: Louise neemt een foto van Mike die een spel speelt, maar hij denkt dat hij er belachelijk uitziet.

programme.title: Grizzy en de Lemmingen
programme.desc: Grizzly vindt de nieuwe elektrische trein van de Lemmingen erg irritant en gooit de Lemmingen bij de buren. Als er daar iets magisch gebeurt kunnen de Lemmingen vervolgens vliegen.

programme.title: Zappsport
programme.desc: Sportprogramma waarin Britt Dekker en Nathan Rutjes de bekendste sporters uitdagen en de meest bizarre wensen laten uitkomen.

programme.title: Ongezien
programme.desc: Jurre en Sahil proberen ongezien te blijven voor een van de bekendste Nederlandse artiesten: Dutchtuber. Tijdens een festival volgen ze Job, die samen met DJ Billy the Kit optreedt. Met hulp van zijn manager Julia en Billy, voeren ze drie uitdagende opdrachten uit. Ze moeten Job vertragen, hem verrassen en uiteindelijk zelfs samen met hem optreden! Lukt het ze om hun missie te volbrengen zonder dat Job doorheeft dat Jurre en Sahil achter de streken zitten?

programme.title: Checkpoint
programme.desc: Rachel rijdt op de velg van een auto, het team test mogelijkheden met een scooter en brengt de brandgevaren van serpentine in beeld. En wie zijn de beste met winkelwagentjes?

programme.title: Welkom bij 75 jaar Jeugd TV
programme.desc: Eenmalige special over 75 jaar jeugdtelevisie van eigen bodem, met Pippi Langkous als iets te energieke hoofdgast op de bank bij Dorine. Met o.a. de eerste tv-uitzending, Theo en Thea en de redding van Het Klokhuis.

programme.title: Welkom thuis
programme.desc: Stap in de chaotische wereld van zeven gezinnen. Eén ding wordt al snel duidelijk: ouders doen maar wat in de hoop dat het goed komt en kinderen generen zich kapot voor alles wat hun ouders doen.

programme.title: Brugklas marathon
programme.desc: Scripted-reality jeugdserie waarin een vaste groep leerlingen gevolgd wordt tijdens het eerste jaar van de middelbare school. Voor schoolgaande kinderen met herkenbare en aangrijpende verhalen.

programme.title: Zappbios: Gugu's wereld
programme.desc: Gugu woont bij zijn oma Dilma, bij wie hij liefde en vrijheid vindt. Hun hechte band trotseert afwijzing van Gugu's vader en van buitenaf, totdat Dilma's broze gezondheid Gugu's wereld doet wankelen.

programme.title: ZappDoc: Het ratje, de mens en de metro
programme.desc: Staartje, een nieuwsgierig ratje, geboren en getogen in de Amsterdamse metro, reist via de Noord-Zuidlijn door de stad. Ze wil begrijpen waarom mensen altijd meer willen, sneller, beter, groter en nooit tevreden lijken. Waarom is genoeg nog altijd niet genoeg? Staartje bestudeert het vreemde gedrag van de mens en ontdekt dat de mens een groter ongedierte is dan de rat.

programme.title: Vlogmania kort
programme.desc: Jaylinn doet haar make-up, maar Jordy verpest haar vlog. De familie Kick doet een bijzondere vondst in de kringloopwinkel.

programme.title: Escape from Albatros
programme.desc: Jayson en Maud bedenken samen met opa Robert en oma Debby een ontsnappingsplan dat bijna mislukt, maar toch weten de vier weg te varen van het eiland Albatros.

programme.desc: Een uitgebreid portret van Céline Dion die haar verhaal deelde in de TV Show. Ook aandacht voor de 80-jarige Olga Zuiderhoek, die nog altijd niet te stoppen is en vertelt over fit blijven, wandelen en haar favoriete ontbijt. In de studio gaat het met Coks Donders en Marieke de Vries over de Amerikaanse midterms en de drijfveren van deze twee vrouwen. programme.desc: Aan de vooravond van Allerzielen staan we stil bij de mensen die we moeten missen. Muziek van onder anderen Roxeanne Hazes en Nick Schilder en een hedendaagse vertelling van het verhaal van Job.

programme.desc: Met het laatste nieuws, gebeurtenissen van nationaal en internationaal belang en de weersverwachting. En op NPO 1 extra met gebarentaal.

programme.title: Nationale lichtjesavond
programme.desc: Aan de vooravond van Allerzielen komen mensen samen voor een bijzonder live openluchtconcert dat in het teken van herinnering staat. Vanuit de Wagenwerkplaats in Amersfoort brengen artiesten als Roxeanne Hazes, Nick Schilder, Jim Bakkum, Zoë Livay en Karsu gevoelige nummers ten gehore. Daarnaast worden er persoonlijke verhalen gedeeld en lichtjes aangestoken. Rode draad van de avond is het eeuwenoude verhaal van Job, een verhaal over verlies, veerkracht en hoop dat voorkomt in de Bijbel, de Koran en de Tenach. Dit verhaal wordt met dramascènes op een hedendaagse manier verteld.

programme.title: Tussen Kunst en Kitsch
programme.desc: Een verzamelaar heeft er 25 jaar over gedaan om een set met Chinese schaaltjes bij elkaar te sparen. De complete set vormt een confituurster, in de 18e eeuw bedoeld om gesuikerd fruit op te leggen. Verder blijkt een zilveren poedersuikerstrooier iets heel anders te zijn en wordt er een geschilderd winterlandschap ontdekt dat de eigenaar alleen in december en januari aan de muur hangt. Expert Esther Aardewerk krijgt de zilveren prijzenset van Jenning de Boo uit de 19e eeuw onder ogen. De schaatser Klaas Hanje bleek zo goed, dat hij een boerderij en koeien van zijn prijzengeld kon kopen.
